notes.title: 1.3.0 "Game Feel" Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060156/6cba45bf10f877d5f2a3e6bc54a0eb3053f339ec.gif[/img]

I got a lot of feedback about "Game Feel!" So I updated it. Now, when you play Nemo Dungeon, you can feel it completely different!

[list]
[*] Added Camera Shake Effects: Carl's first skill, Red's first skill, Pale's first and third skill
[*] Added Time Stop Effects: Carl's first and third skill, Red's first and second skill, Pale's fourth skill
[*] Added Shockwave Effects: Enemy death, Player death, Carl's fourth skill, Red's second and fourth skill, Pale's  second and fourth skill
[*] Added leaning knockback effects
[*] Added stun effects falling on back
[*] Changed Carl's second skill to pass enemies except bosses
[*] Fixed a player stats speed point bug.
[/list]

Have a nice day!

- Changed BGM.
- Changed the Red's 4th skill.

- Increased the Red's 3rd skill attack power from 10 to 20
- Changed the Red's 3rd skill to heal a player 5% of the damage.
- Made that Each difficulty enemies have different bullet number and cooltime, etc.
- Reduced player characters basic attack power from 20 to 15 in easy mode.
- Reduced player characters basic attack power from 10 to 9 in hard mode.
- Reduced player characters basic attack power from 10 to 8 in hell mode.
- Reduced enemy basic attack power from 30 to 20 in hard mode.
- Reduced enemy basic attack power from 200 to 30 in hell mode.
- Added information texts when a player goes down to a next level.
- Added keyboard settings and controller settings.

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
I fixed a few bugs.

- Fixed a bug that HP bar shows a negative health point when a player die
- Fixed a bug that a locked warning popup in the character choice scene cannot be closed by a controller
- Fixed a bug that a item key tag say "LT" not "LB"
- Fixed a bug that a item key tag does not disappear if a player enters again the position of the item after he/she gets it.

I make Nemo Dungeon a little easy.

- Increase the cool time of machine gunner who have a red head.
- Fixed some map enemy arrangements.
